race.description: Tom Molloy Service To Racing Showcase Hcp (C2)
race.comment: DAWN ON ME (1) bolted in two runs back in a Class 3 over 1005m at the Sapphire Coast. Earned a crack at a Highway after that performance and wasn't disgraced at Rosehill over today's trip, finishing fourth. Finds a lovely race and is very well in after the claim. The speedy KEVIN (2) just failed in his bid to lead all the way first-up over this distance in Dubbo in what has turned out to be a strong form race. Dropped back to 950m at Cowra last time and they couldn't catch him. Up in grade but will run another bold race. BEDDA MIA (10) comes here fresh from an eight-week let-up. Got a long way back and could only manage third behind DAWN ON ME at the Sapphire Coast at the last appearance. Should give a good account from the inside draw. BOLO MISS (7) had been in the top three at 11 of 12 runs before failing in a Rosehill Highway recently. Cannot be sacked after one bad run. WANDAYE (8) might surprise off a six-week let-up.
